brief: Draft the scene in Japanese: that afternoon, 遥 walks up the slope from the station and lets herself into her grandmother's house. Nobody else appears, and she does not learn what 大島 has kept. Close third person, past tense, under 500 characters, with numbers in kanji and dialogue in 「」 as the style sheet sets them. Keep every established fact. Invent nothing.
name: drafting-ja
